description.value: Crystal Cove Beach Resort is a highly-rated oceanfront property on MacKenzie Beach in Tofino, offering 34 modern log cabins, serviced RV sites, and glamping trailers with 5th-wheel RVs — rated #1 Resort in Tofino and #1 in Canada for Families on TripAdvisor. The resort sits directly on a kilometre of sandy coastline with tidal rocks and small islands accessible at low tide, making it a destination in itself. An on-site café, Bean at the Cove, and fully stocked cabin kitchens round out the self-contained experience.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is fully accessible and provides rich detail about Crystal Cove Beach Resort's cabin, RV, and glamping offerings. The cabin amenities page lists extensive in-cabin equipment (kitchen appliances, bedding, entertainment) but makes no mention of bike storage, laundry, Wi-Fi, or any cycling-specific services. The about page and FAQ confirm the resort is open and operating in 2026. OSM has no phone or address, so those are taken from the website.
concerns: OSM record contains no phone number or street address; phone and partial address taken from website.
No cycling-specific amenities (bike storage, laundry, Wi-Fi, e-bike charging) mentioned anywhere on the website — all relevant fields remain null.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, operating, publicly bookable resort in Tofino with an active website and 2026 operational notices. A clear and useful accommodation listing for touring cyclists visiting the area.
enrichment_extras.notes: The FAQ explicitly states the RV Park does not accommodate tent camping or car camping, only recreational vehicles. Cyclists seeking a camping option here would need a cabin or glamping booking.

wow_evidence: rated #1 Resort in Tofino and #1 in Canada for Families on TripAdvisor

price.label: Upscale
price.signal: 34 modern log cabins on MacKenzie Beach, #1-rated; cabins $300+ (RV sites cheaper)
